Answer: C
Reason: The CT images (Figures 1a-c) demonstrate small, well-defined nodules distributed along the peribronchovascular bundles and subpleural regions (fissures), which is the classic radiological pattern for sarcoidosis. This distribution distinguishes it from the random pattern of miliary TB or the centrilobular pattern of inhalation diseases.
